SCPF1.label: Performance & Functionality Issues

SCPF1.1.label: Page / Search Error
SCPF1.1.description: Definition: A page or search returns an error for a user who can access Scopus.

SCPF1.2.label: Feature Malfunction
SCPF1.2.description: Definition: A Scopus feature does not behave as expected.

SCPF1.4.label: Slow / Not Loading
SCPF1.4.description: Definition: Pages load slowly or not at all.

SCPF1.5.label: Browser Compatibility
SCPF1.5.description: Definition: The problem is tied to a specific browser or device.

SCPF1.6.label: Export Stuck in Queue
SCPF1.6.description: Definition: An export request stays queued or never completes.

SCPF1.7.label: Unknown / Not Stated
SCPF1.7.description: Definition: The technical cause is not stated.

SCPF1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Performance & Functionality Issues'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Performance & Functionality Issues' means: Definition: Formerly 'Technical Error'. Export or download failures, exports stuck in a queue, feature malfunctions, page or search errors, slow loading and browser problems for a customer who can access Scopus.
